cn.speaker: 旁白
cn.text: 上午九点，第二手术室。这是武見妙正式获准进入排班表后，由我主刀、她担任第一助手配合的一台清醒开腹手术。

cn.speaker: 旁白
cn.text: 无影灯下，躺在手术台上的年轻女患者没有接受全身麻醉。随着我用圆刀片稳稳切开右侧腹直肌前鞘与腹膜，温润鲜活的腹腔内部结构随之暴露在视野中。

cn.speaker: 本庄萌恵
cn.text: 「坂、坂口医生，拉钩和温盐水纱布已经准备好了……」

cn.speaker: 武見妙
cn.text: 「别急着把纱布全垫进去嘛，坂口。你看这姑娘的肠系膜血管弓，在完全没有麻药降压抑制的状态下，搏动得简直像艺术品一样。」

cn.speaker: 旁白
cn.text: 站在我对面的武見妙眼神发亮，戴着无菌手套的双手握住腹壁牵开器，手腕熟练地向外侧一沉——原本只开了标准宽度的切口被她顺势撑开了整整一圈。

cn.speaker: 女患者
cn.text: 「唔……！等、等一下，医生……肚子被往两边拉得好紧……虽、虽然刚才切开的时候忍住了，但这样撑开的话，里面感觉好奇怪……！」

cn.speaker: 坂口隆司
cn.text: 「武見，现在的暴露视野已经够我操作了，不用把拉钩撑到最大。」

cn.speaker: 武見妙
cn.text: 「机会难得嘛。喂，那边端托盘的小护士——叫本庄是吧？把头探过来一点。」

cn.speaker: 本庄萌恵
cn.text: 「咦？我、我吗？是！」

cn.speaker: 旁白
cn.text: 萌恵战战兢兢地往前凑了半步。武見用一把无损伤组织镊轻轻托起患者正在微微蠕动的回肠末端与系膜根部，像在大学讲堂里做示范一样指点起来：

cn.speaker: 武見妙
cn.text: 「平时在护理课本上看的都是死气沉沉的插图吧？仔细看这里——清醒状态下，只要我的镊子稍微碰一下浆膜层，肠管就会自己收缩逃开，连边缘的小动脉都在一下一下跳动。」

cn.speaker: 本庄萌恵
cn.text: 「哇……真的在动……！原来活生生的内脏实际看起来是这样……比教材上的图清楚好多……」

cn.speaker: 女患者
cn.text: 「呜……！那个，医生、护士小姐……请不要当着教材本人的面，一边翻我的肚子一边讨论教材质量啊……！」

cn.speaker: 坂口隆司
cn.text: 「好了，武見教授的现场解剖课到此为止。萌恵，递弯血管钳给我；武見，帮我稳住拉钩，我们准备处理病灶。」

cn.speaker: 武見妙
cn.text: 「啧，真严格。不过你的刀口开得确实干净，连一滴多余的渗血都没有——给这种主刀打下手，倒也不算无聊。」

cn.speaker: 旁白
cn.text: 手术顺利结束、患者送回病房观察后，时间刚过十一点。我顺着楼梯来到医院最底层的地下研究室，推开门时，武見妙正翘着修长的双腿坐在转椅上，慢悠悠地喝着冰咖啡。

cn.speaker: 武見妙
cn.text: 「哟，大主刀。怎么，是替城宮院长那个小丫头来训话的，还是来跟我算刚才在台上撑大拉钩的账？」

cn.speaker: 坂口隆司
cn.text: 「要算账的话，刚才在刷手池就说了。只是刚才萌恵脱口而出说你讲得比教材还细的时候，护士站那帮小姑娘看你的眼神，又多了一条医院怪谈素材。」

cn.speaker: 武見妙
cn.text: 「怪谈？让我猜猜，是不是又在传『地下室那个姓武見的女人，其实是个喜欢拿活人做生体解剖的疯子』？」

cn.speaker: 武見妙
cn.text: 「哈哈，全医院敢当着我的面直接问这句话的，除了城宮那丫头，你还是第一个。」

cn.speaker: 坂口隆司
cn.text: 「毕竟站在你对面配合了一整台手术，想装作没看出来都难。」

cn.speaker: 武見妙
cn.text: 「彼此彼此吧，坂口医生。你敢在不用麻药的情况下一刀切得那么稳，也没资格说我是怪人。」

cn.speaker: 坂口隆司
cn.text: 「我那是为了临床训练和特殊病例。你倒好，护士们私底下都在传你的终极爱好是『生体解剖』。」

cn.speaker: 武見妙
cn.text: 「『生体解剖』这个词被外行弄得太难听了。好像只要一提起这四个字，就非得把实验对象折磨死在台子上不可一样。」

cn.speaker: 旁白
cn.text: 她放下咖啡杯，身体微微前倾，涂着暗色唇膏的嘴角勾起一抹理所当然的弧度：

cn.speaker: 武見妙
cn.text: 「我上初中的时候，生物课有一次解剖青蛙的实验。全班同学都在那里大惊小怪，把青蛙肚子剪得稀巴烂。」

cn.speaker: 武見妙
cn.text: 「我就觉得很奇怪——明明我们只是想观察活体状态下的心脏跳动、肺叶张缩和肠管走向，为什么非要弄死它不可呢？」

cn.speaker: 坂口隆司
cn.text: 「……所以你当时做了什么？」

cn.speaker: 武見妙
cn.text: 「我避开大血管打开腹腔，把里面每一处跳动的脏器都仔仔细细看了一遍、画完了图；然后用我自己带去的最细的缝合针线，按解剖层次给它原样缝好，最后把它从蜡盘上翻了过来。」

cn.speaker: 坂口隆司
cn.text: 「然后呢？活下来了？」

cn.speaker: 武見妙
cn.text: 「它蹬了蹬腿，自己从实验桌上跳着走了。」

cn.speaker: 旁白
cn.text: 她说得极其平静，仿佛那只是一堂再普通不过的手工课。

cn.speaker: 坂口隆司
cn.text: 「……生物老师当时的表情一定很精彩。」

cn.speaker: 武見妙
cn.text: 「老师吓得差点把教案扔出去。可是在星见医院不也是一样的道理吗？既然这里的医疗条件能保证无论开多大的口子、把里面翻得多彻底，最后缝起来都能完好无损地恢复——那趁着人还清醒、内脏还在鲜活搏动的时候多看两眼，有什么不对？」

cn.speaker: 坂口隆司
cn.text: 「原来上次城宮院长禁止你独立主刀，就是因为你想把患者当成那只青蛙？」

cn.speaker: 武見妙
cn.text: 「上次那台只是稍微开深了一点，谁知道第3手术室那张旧手术台的液压支架那么不结实，居然在半路卡死了。城宮那丫头大惊小怪，非说我再开下去要把人和手术台一起拆了。」

cn.speaker: 旁白
cn.text: 她懒洋洋地靠回椅背上，抬眼打量着我，眼神里多了一丝找到同类的饶有兴味：

cn.speaker: 武見妙
cn.text: 「不过跟在你旁边当助手倒是挺省心的。至少我把切口撑开的时候，你的手一点都没抖，眼神甚至比我还专注。」

cn.speaker: 坂口隆司
cn.text: 「只要不耽误正经手术，让你顺便给新人讲两句解剖课我没意见。」

cn.speaker: 武見妙
cn.text: 「只是普通患者还是太娇气了点。哪怕不打麻药，只要拉钩稍微往两边多拉两公分、或者手伸进去翻一下肠管，她们就痛得直叫唤，吵得人没法静下心来细看。」

cn.speaker: 旁白
cn.text: 武見用食指轻轻抵着下巴，像是随口许愿般轻叹了一声：

cn.speaker: 武見妙
cn.text: 「要是哪天能来一个**天生感觉不到痛的患者**就好了。不用打麻药，也不会因为切开而大喊大叫……那样的话，我一定去跟城宮申请一次特批主刀，拉上你当第一助手，把活生生的腹腔从上到下看个够。」

cn.speaker: 坂口隆司
cn.text: 「哪有那么巧的事。真有先天无痛症的患者，平时连自己生病都察觉不到，等你遇到的时候，肚子里指不定已经拖成什么样了。」

cn.speaker: 武見妙
cn.text: 「那不是更有趣了吗？既能看健康的活体结构，又能顺手收拾烂摊子。……行了，差不多到中午十二点了，去吃你的午饭吧，搭档。下午要是还有不打麻药的刀，记得叫我。」

cn.speaker: 旁白
cn.text: 早上九点，刚到医院打卡上班，我就被武見妙一通电话叫进了院长室。办公桌后，年轻的城宮明日香院长正捏着一份转诊病历，满脸警惕地盯着对面的武見。

cn.speaker: 城宮明日香
cn.text: 「我再确认最后一次哦，武見医生。这位叫浅上藤乃的二十岁女大学生患者，是因为长期无痛症掩盖了慢性阑尾炎反复穿孔，导致右下腹形成了波及回盲部、大网膜和右侧附件的广泛炎性粘连包块，我才特批由你主刀、坂口医生担任第一助手的。」

cn.speaker: 武見妙
cn.text: 「我知道，病历就是我昨天从门诊筛出来的嘛。坂口现在的刀法够稳，有他在台对面帮我拉钩止血，你还有什么不放心的？」

cn.speaker: 城宮明日香
cn.text: 「我不放心的就是你本人！听好了——第一，普通地做。」

cn.speaker: 武見妙
cn.text: 「当然。」

cn.speaker: 城宮明日香
cn.text: 「第二，不准在手术台上临时拉小护士搞现场解剖教学。」

cn.speaker: 武見妙
cn.text: 「今天器械护士排的是朝仓，她比我还熟，不用我教。」

cn.speaker: 城宮明日香
cn.text: 「第三——**绝对不准借着患者没痛觉，额外扩大术野去翻看没生病的脏器！**」

cn.speaker: 城宮明日香
cn.text: 「你为什么突然沉默了？！回答我呀！坂口医生，今天你在台上除了当第一助手，还要负责给我盯紧她的手！」

cn.speaker: 坂口隆司
cn.text: 「放心吧，院长。我会确保手术按标准解剖层次安全完成的。」

cn.speaker: 旁白
cn.text: 离开院长室后，我与武見一同来到第一诊察室。检查床边坐着一位留着及腰乌黑长发、气质温婉端庄的年轻女性——浅上藤乃。

cn.speaker: 浅上藤乃
cn.text: 「武見医生，坂口医生，早安。今天为了我的身体劳烦两位专家同台，实在非常感激。」

cn.speaker: 旁白
cn.text: 她微笑着欠了欠身，举手投足间透着名门闺秀特有的良好教养，丝毫看不出右下腹藏着一团足以让普通人痛到休克的严重化脓粘连病灶。

cn.speaker: 武見妙
cn.text: 「客套话就免了，浅上小姐。术前最后做一次腹部触诊确认边界——躺到检查床上，把裙子腰扣松开，毛衣拉到胸口上面吧。」

cn.speaker: 浅上藤乃
cn.text: 「好的，失礼了。」

cn.speaker: 旁白
cn.text: 浅上顺从地平躺在检查床上，纤白的手指将针织衫下摆向上卷起，露出一截平坦紧致、连一丝赘肉都没有的雪白腰腹。

cn.speaker: 武見妙
cn.text: 「坂口，你也戴上手套来摸摸看。这种程度的右下腹炎性包块，放在普通女孩子身上，手指刚碰到肚皮她就该尖叫着弹起来了。」

cn.speaker: 旁白
cn.text: 我戴好检查手套走到床侧，将手掌轻轻覆在浅上微凉的右下腹皮肤上，随后并拢四指，向腹腔深处缓缓用力按压下去。

cn.speaker: 旁白
cn.text: 指腹隔着柔软的腹壁肌层，清晰地触碰到了一团质地坚硬、与周围肠管和盆壁紧紧粘连在一起的深部包块。然而躺着的名门少女连眉头都没有皱一下，只是因为男性手掌深入按压小腹的动作，耳根渐渐浮起一层薄红。

cn.speaker: 浅上藤乃
cn.text: 「唔……坂口医生的手，比我想象的还要有力气呢……我可以很清楚地感觉到您的手指陷进了肚子最深处，正按着那团硬邦邦的东西……只是，真的完全感觉不到疼。」

cn.speaker: 坂口隆司
cn.text: 「正是因为你从小感觉通路受阻，阑尾反复发炎穿孔都被身体当成了普通的腹胀，才会把回盲部、大网膜甚至右侧卵巢输卵管周围全粘成了一团。」

cn.speaker: 武見妙
cn.text: 「而且根据我和影像科御园医生的读片结果，你右下腹深处那团瘢痕组织正好压迫了腹膜后的神经丛——换句话说，你现在的无痛症，很大一部分也是被这团陈旧病灶给锁住的。」

cn.speaker: 浅上藤乃
cn.text: 「原来是这样……难怪这两年我连扭伤脚踝都没什么感觉。那么关于下午的手术方式……」

cn.speaker: 武見妙
cn.text: 「就像刚才跟你说明的一样，如果在全身麻醉下开刀，麻药会掩盖你神经功能的临界反应；既然你现在本来就没有痛觉，我们干脆采用**完全不打麻药的无麻醉开腹手术**。你敢签字吗？」

cn.speaker: 浅上藤乃
cn.text: 「既然本来就不觉得疼，省去麻醉对身体反而更好吧？只是……听说一旦签了星见医院的手术同意书，上了手术台之后哪怕害怕也不能中途取消了，是吗？」

cn.speaker: 坂口隆司
cn.text: 「是。一旦签字进入准备流程，直到我们把病变切干净、把肚子重新缝合好之前，手术都不会停下。」

cn.speaker: 浅上藤乃
cn.text: 「我明白了。反正我也不会因为疼痛而哭闹，那就拜托武見医生和坂口医生了。」

cn.speaker: 旁白
cn.text: 中午十二点半，在病房由朝仓美幸替浅上做完全套备皮、肠道清洁与留置导尿准备后，这位一丝不挂的黑长直少女被推进了手术室，平躺在无影灯正下方的手术台上。

cn.speaker: 朝倉美幸
cn.text: 「双臂约束带已经固定好了，导尿管引流顺畅，腹部与会阴备皮区的碘伏消毒也已完成。浅上小姐从刚才在病房脱掉衣服插导尿管到现在，心跳才稍微快了一点点，真是个乖巧得让人心疼的患者呢。」

cn.speaker: 浅上藤乃
cn.text: 「因为……虽然感觉不到疼，但在完全清醒的状态下不穿衣服躺在这里，双腿间还插着管子被三位医护人员围着看……还是会觉得很难为情的……」

cn.speaker: 武見妙
cn.text: 「害羞说明你的触觉和情绪反应都很健康。来，朝仓，给我20号圆刀片；坂口，准备干纱布按压切口两侧。」

cn.speaker: 旁白
cn.text: 无菌洞巾铺好后，武見没有半点犹豫，锋利的刀尖沿着浅上平坦雪白的腹正中线偏右侧稳稳落下。皮肤与鹅黄色的皮下脂肪层应声分开，鲜红的血珠刚刚涌出，便被我用纱布精准拭去。

cn.speaker: 旁白
cn.text: 紧接着是电刀切开腹直肌前鞘、钝性分离鲜红的腹直肌肌腹、提起半透明的腹膜剪开——整个开腹过程干净利落。令人惊叹的是，躺在台上的浅上除了在刀锋划开肚皮时轻轻颤了一下睫毛，呼吸竟依然保持着平稳。

cn.speaker: 浅上藤乃
cn.text: 「唔……刚才肚子上有一种被冰凉的刀片划开、然后向两边敞开的感觉……原来这就是肚子被切开的感觉吗？真的……一点都不疼呢。」

cn.speaker: 旁白
cn.text: 武見妙口罩上方的双眸瞬间亮得惊人。她把Balfour自动腹壁牵开器放进切口，咔哒几声将金属拉钩撑到最大，把浅上的腹腔大大方方地敞开在无影灯下，随后突然停下手里的动作，低头笑吟吟地看向清醒的浅上：

cn.speaker: 武見妙
cn.text: 「呐，浅上小姐。你看，你的肚子现在已经完全打开了，而你又真的一点都不觉得痛。」

cn.speaker: 浅上藤乃
cn.text: 「是……请问武見医生，有什么问题吗？」

cn.speaker: 武見妙
cn.text: 「既然开都开了，机会这么难得……在切掉右下腹那团发炎粘连的烂摊子之前，我们顺便把你肚子里其他健康的脏器也从头到尾检查得细致一点，好不好？」

cn.speaker: 坂口隆司
cn.text: 「喂，武見，你忘了早上城宮院长第三条是怎么交代的了？」

cn.speaker: 朝倉美幸
cn.text: 「呵呵，我就知道武見医生看到这么听话又不会喊疼的患者，绝对忍不了一上来就直接做正事呢。」

cn.speaker: 旁白
cn.text: 然而躺在手术台上的浅上藤乃却眨了眨那双清澈的黑眸，极其认真地问出了一个让我们三个人同时愣住的问题：

cn.speaker: 浅上藤乃
cn.text: 「请问……如果顺便把肚子里其他地方也仔细检查一遍的话，手术费还是一样的吗？」

cn.speaker: 武見妙
cn.text: 「噗……哈哈！一样的，一分钱都不多收，算本主刀附赠给你的全套活体内脏体检。」

cn.speaker: 浅上藤乃
cn.text: 「既然手术费一样，我又感觉不到疼……那就随两位医生喜欢吧。请尽管仔细检查。」

cn.speaker: 武見妙
cn.text: 「听到没有，朝仓？我们的第一助手也投赞成票了。把无菌温盐水拿过来，我们先把手套润湿。」

cn.speaker: 坂口隆司
cn.text: 「我只是怕你不看个过瘾，等会儿连正经剥离病灶都不专心。」

cn.speaker: 武見妙
cn.text: 「安啦，我的手法你还不清楚吗？比摸那只初中青蛙还要温柔十倍。」

cn.speaker: 坂口隆司
cn.text: 「别当着患者的面提你那只青蛙，浅上小姐会当真的。」

cn.speaker: 旁白
cn.text: 得到浅上本人的许可后，武見妙彻底放开了手脚。她将浸泡过温热生理盐水的双手直接探入浅上完全敞开的腹腔深处，先从上腹部的胃大弯与横结肠开始，一寸一寸地托起、翻看那些粉润鲜活、正随着呼吸微微起伏的脏器。

cn.speaker: 浅上藤乃
cn.text: 「唔……！哈啊……等、等一下，武見医生……」

cn.speaker: 武見妙
cn.text: 「怎么？会痛吗？」

cn.speaker: 浅上藤乃
cn.text: 「不、不是痛……真的完全不痛……可是，您的手伸进我肚子里面把肠子托起来的时候……里面有一种说不出的下坠感和拉扯感……好像内脏要被整个端出来了一样……嗯、哈啊……」

cn.speaker: 旁白
cn.text: 无痛症只阻断了尖锐的痛觉，却没有夺走内脏系膜被牵拉时的深部本体感觉与迷走神经反射。随着武見戴着湿滑乳胶手套的手指沿着小肠系膜一节一节向盆腔方向捋过，浅上白皙的额头渗出细密的薄汗，呼吸变得越来越急促。

cn.speaker: 武見妙
cn.text: 「坂口，别光在旁边看，把手伸进来帮我把这几段空肠和回肠轻轻往左上方托住。你看她盆腔左侧这边的卵巢和输卵管，完全没有被右侧的炎症波及，色泽多漂亮。」

cn.speaker: 旁白
cn.text: 我顺着武見的指示，将戴着无菌手套的双手探入浅上温热湿滑的腹腔内，掌心轻轻托住她柔软蠕动的肠管向一侧拨开；而武見的手指则顺着子宫底滑向左侧附件，用指腹轻轻捏了捏那枚健康的卵巢与伞端。

cn.speaker: 浅上藤乃
cn.text: 「呀啊……！唔、嗯……！坂口医生……武見医生……四只手同时在我肚子里面动来动去……太、太奇怪了……！」

cn.speaker: 坂口隆司
cn.text: 「忍耐一下，浅上小姐。我现在托着的是你的小肠，武見医生正在确认你左侧健康的子宫附件。」

cn.speaker: 浅上藤乃
cn.text: 「哈啊……我、我知道你们是在做检查……可是明明不疼，为什么被坂口医生的手掌托着肠子、又被武見医生摸着小腹最深处的时候……身体里面会又酸又胀、连脚趾头都使不上力气了……呜、好奇怪……肚子里面被摸遍了……」

cn.speaker: 朝倉美幸
cn.text: 「呵呵，脸色红得像发烧一样呢，浅上小姐。虽然没有痛觉，但女孩子最隐秘的肚子内部被主刀和助手一寸寸摸遍，这种羞耻感可是比疼痛还要厉害的哦。」

cn.speaker: 浅上藤乃
cn.text: 「唔嗯……请、请别说了，朝仓护士……连肠子在你们手心里蠕动的感觉都传到脑子里来了……还没检查完吗……？」

cn.speaker: 武見妙
cn.text: 「好啦，健康的部位已经看够了，确实是一具非常漂亮的身体。——接下来该干正事了，坂口，把拉钩转向右下腹髂窝。」

cn.speaker: 旁白
cn.text: 玩够了的武見妙眼神瞬间变得锐利如鹰。刚才那种懒散戏谑的气息一扫而空，取而代之的是与御堂江美子不相上下的顶级外科统治力。

cn.speaker: 旁白
cn.text: 在浅上的右下腹深处，慢性阑尾炎长年反复穿孔形成的浓稠脓腔与肉芽瘢痕，已经将盲肠下端、部分大网膜以及右侧输卵管壶腹部死死包裹成了一团坚硬的炎性包块，最深处的纤维索带更是直接压迫在腹膜后神经丛上。

cn.speaker: 坂口隆司
cn.text: 「右侧输卵管和卵巢只是被炎性纤维膜粘连包裹住了，实质还没有坏死。如果精细剥离的话，右侧附件完全可以保住，只需要切除坏死的阑尾根部、部分回盲部炎性组织和受累大网膜。」

cn.speaker: 武見妙
cn.text: 「正合我意。我可不喜欢把女孩子有用的零件随便切掉。朝仓，换精细分离钳和双极电凝；坂口，帮我牵引住右侧卵巢韧带，一毫米都不准晃。」

cn.speaker: 旁白
cn.text: 无影灯下只剩下器械交接的清脆声响与电凝的轻微滋滋声。武見的刀法快而极准，在布满炎性充血血管的粘连带中游刃有余地穿行，先将浅上右侧完好的卵巢与输卵管毫发无损地从包块外壁剥离出来。

cn.speaker: 浅上藤乃
cn.text: 「唔……右边肚子深处被拉扯得更重了……像有一块石头正被你们一点点从肉上撕下来一样……哈啊、还是不疼的，请继续吧……」

cn.speaker: 武見妙
cn.text: 「马上就到最底下压迫神经丛的那层瘢痕根部了。坂口，夹住回盲部系膜血管，准备结扎切离——」

cn.speaker: 旁白
cn.text: 随着我稳稳打好双重结扎线，武見妙手中的组织剪精准地探入腹膜后最深处，对准那道死死勒住感觉神经通路的致密炎性包块根部，干脆利落地一剪到底——

cn.speaker: 旁白
cn.text: 「咔嚓。」那团折磨、封锁了浅上藤乃身体知觉多年的黑红色炎性包块被彻底切下，落入了朝仓端着的弯盘里。

cn.speaker: 旁白
cn.text: 就在病灶脱离腹膜后神经丛的同一秒钟——

cn.speaker: 旁白
cn.text: 浅上原本只是因为牵拉而微蹙的眉头猛地一僵，瞳孔骤然收缩。下一瞬，被阻断了多年的痛觉信号如同决堤的洪水般，从敞开着整条切口、正在渗血的右下腹腔直接冲进了她的大脑皮层！

cn.speaker: 浅上藤乃
cn.text: 「——呀啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊——！！！」

cn.speaker: 旁白
cn.text: 一声凄厉到变调的惨叫瞬间响彻整个手术室！刚才还温婉端庄、任由我们在肚子里翻看内脏的名门千金，整个人在手术台上剧烈地弹动弓起，手腕将两侧约束带扯得啪啪作响，豆大的泪珠瞬间夺眶而出！

cn.speaker: 浅上藤乃
cn.text: 「疼！！好疼啊啊啊——！！肚子、我的肚子为什么突然像被火烧、被刀割一样疼啊？！！呜啊啊啊——！！」

cn.speaker: 坂口隆司
cn.text: 「心率直接飙到一百三十了！朝仓，按住她的双肩别让她乱动把肠管挤出切口！看来刚才切下腹膜后包块的瞬间，压迫神经丛的阻滞被彻底解除了——她的痛觉当场恢复了！」

cn.speaker: 浅上藤乃
cn.text: 「武見医生！！坂口医生！！我不要不打麻药了！！好疼、肚子真的被切开了好疼啊！！快给我打麻药……求求你们现在给我打全身麻醉好不好？！！呜啊啊啊——！！」

cn.speaker: 旁白
cn.text: 面对在手术台上痛得泪流满面、拼命哭喊求麻药的浅上，主刀位上的武見妙不仅没有丝毫慌乱，反而慢条斯理地直起腰，在口罩上方弯起眼睛笑了起来：

cn.speaker: 武見妙
cn.text: 「恭喜你啊，浅上小姐。看来手术非常成功，不仅把烂掉的包块切干净了，连你的无痛症也顺便彻底治好了。」

cn.speaker: 浅上藤乃
cn.text: 「呜啊啊啊我不要现在恭喜啊！！疼死我了……连呼吸一下肚子里面都在抽着疼！！麻药……我现在加钱也可以，求求你们给我打麻药让我睡过去吧！！」

cn.speaker: 武見妙
cn.text: 「现在才求麻药？太晚啦，浅上小姐。」

cn.speaker: 武見妙
cn.text: 「最难的切除步骤已经做完了，接下来就剩用温盐水把腹腔冲干净、检查出血点，再一层一层给你缝合关腹。现在就算去叫樱花主任过来给你做全麻插管，等麻药起效的时候，我和坂口连最后一针皮肤线都打完结了。」

cn.speaker: 浅上藤乃
cn.text: 「怎、怎么这样……？！那我接下来岂不是要活生生忍受着冲洗和缝肚子的疼，一直到手术结束吗？！」

cn.speaker: 浅上藤乃
cn.text: 「呜……坂口医生……您的手按在刀口边上的时候，连手套擦过肉里的疼都清楚得要命……拜托你们快一点……！」

cn.speaker: 武見妙
cn.text: 「听见没有，大主刀？人家姑娘催我们了——不过清创冲洗可不能偷工减料，得慢条斯理地洗干净才不会留术后感染。」

cn.speaker: 武見妙
cn.text: 「这就心疼啦？能亲眼看到无痛症患者在自己刀下找回痛觉，这可是千金难买的临床瞬间呢。」

cn.speaker: 坂口隆司
cn.text: 「对医生来说是奇迹，对躺在台上的浅上小姐来说可是实打实的酷刑。朝仓，递温生理盐水和吸引器。」

cn.speaker: 旁白
cn.text: 接下来的四十分钟，成了这位名门大小姐人生中第一次真正的“痛觉洗礼”。当大量温生理盐水倾入敞开的腹盆腔、细致地冲洗刚才剥离包块留下的创面时，浅上咬紧下唇，眼泪顺着鬓角不停地滑落进手术帽边缘。

cn.speaker: 浅上藤乃
cn.text: 「唔嗯——！！哈啊、啊……水、水冲在肚子里面的伤口上了……好刺痛……连吸水管吸走血水的时候，里面都在一抽一抽地疼……呜呜……」

cn.speaker: 朝倉美幸
cn.text: 「好孩子，再坚持一下下哦，浅上小姐。刚才把整个肚子翻过来检查的时候你都一声没吭，现在能这么大声地喊疼，说明你的身体已经彻底恢复正常了呢。」

cn.speaker: 旁白
cn.text: 冲洗完毕、确认右侧附件与肠管复位无误后，武見与我开始一针一针地逐层关腹。每当弯针带着缝线穿过敏感的腹膜、拉拢腹直肌鞘并收紧线结时，浅上都会因为清晰的穿刺牵拉痛而浑身紧绷、漏出带着哭腔的抽气声。

cn.speaker: 浅上藤乃
cn.text: 「啊……！疼、这一针拉得好紧……肚子被一针一针缝起来了……呜、我再也不要相信『不打麻药也没关系』这种话了……！」

cn.speaker: 武見妙
cn.text: 「最后一针皮内缝合——剪线。好了，伤口对合得非常漂亮，连疤痕都不会留。」

cn.speaker: 旁白
cn.text: 傍晚五点，术后观察病房。得益于星见医院的恢复保障，下午刚经历了一场大开腹手术的浅上藤乃已经换上了整洁的病号服靠坐在床头，只是脸色还带着几分大哭过后的微红。

cn.speaker: 旁白
cn.text: 当我与武見推门进来做下班前的最后一次查房时，浅上正低头用指尖隔着薄薄的纱布敷料，小心翼翼地碰了碰自己的右下腹，随即「嘶」地倒吸了一口凉气。

cn.speaker: 坂口隆司
cn.text: 「别自己乱按刀口，刚缝合好的地方肯定还疼。」

cn.speaker: 浅上藤乃
cn.text: 「对不起，坂口医生，武見医生……刚才在手术台上，我最后哭叫得那么失态，还死缠烂打地求你们加麻药……实在让您二位见笑了。」

cn.speaker: 武見妙
cn.text: 「不用道歉。要是刚把腹膜后神经丛的压迫解开、肚子还敞着口子的时候你都一声不吭，那才说明我的手术失败了呢。」

cn.speaker: 旁白
cn.text: 浅上垂下眼帘，双手轻轻覆在腹部下方，眼角忽然又泛起了一点晶莹的泪光，但嘴角却弯起了一抹无比真实的温柔笑意：

cn.speaker: 浅上藤乃
cn.text: 「其实……回到病房冷静下来之后，我摸着这里一跳一跳的钝痛，心里觉得特别不可思议。」

cn.speaker: 浅上藤乃
cn.text: 「以前不管身体里烂成什么样，我都像隔着一层毛玻璃活着一样，什么都感觉不到。刚才在手术台上虽然疼得要命，还被两位医生把肚子里面看了个遍……但现在能像普通女孩子一样感觉到疼、被坂口医生关心着叮嘱『别乱按刀口』，真的让我觉得自己还好好地活着。」

cn.speaker: 坂口隆司
cn.text: 「你的右侧卵巢和输卵管也都完好无损地保住了，炎症包块已经彻底清理干净。好好休息一晚，明天就可以正常下床活动了。」

cn.speaker: 浅上藤乃
cn.text: 「是，非常感谢两位医生。」

cn.speaker: 旁白
cn.text: 从病房出来时，窗外已经是傍晚六点的暮色。武見妙双手插在白大褂口袋里，慢悠悠地与我并肩走在通往地下室的走廊上。

cn.speaker: 武見妙
cn.text: 「呼……今天这一整天过得还真是充实。前半场安安静静地把活体腹盆腔摸了个遍，后半场又听到了那么精神的惨叫声。」

cn.speaker: 坂口隆司
cn.text: 「也就是浅上小姐脾气好，换做别的患者，知道你趁她没痛觉的时候附赠了一套『全腹腔手工翻看服务』，出院前非去院长室告你的状不可。」

cn.speaker: 武見妙
cn.text: 「她要是去告状，你这个把双手伸进人家肚子里帮我托着小肠的第一助手也是共犯，跑不掉的。」

cn.speaker: 旁白
cn.text: 她停在地下室楼梯口，转过身看着我，向来慵懒戏谑的眼眸里难得流露出一分认真的赞许：

cn.speaker: 武見妙
cn.text: 「不过说真的，坂口……刚才她痛觉突然恢复、在台上挣扎的时候，换作普通助手早就慌了神，你却能一边稳稳帮我按住切口护住肠管，一边丝毫不乱地配合我把整台清创关腹做完。」

cn.speaker: 武見妙
cn.text: 「在星见医院待了这么久，我还是第一次遇到能把我的节奏接得这么舒服的男人。……走吧，今天累了一整天，去我的地下室喝一杯，算本主刀犒劳你的。」

en.speaker: Narrator
en.text: Nine o'clock in the morning, Operating Room 2. Since Tae Takemi was officially cleared to join our surgical roster, this is a routine awake laparotomy with me as lead surgeon and her assisting across the table.

en.speaker: Narrator
en.text: Beneath the shadowless lamp, the young female patient on the table has been given no general anesthesia. As my scalpel steadily incises the right anterior rectus sheath and peritoneum, the warm, living structures inside her abdominal cavity come into view.

en.speaker: Moe Honjo
en.text: "D-Dr. Sakaguchi, the retractors and warm saline laparotomy pads are ready..."

en.speaker: Tae Takemi
en.text: "No need to pack the gauze in so quickly, Sakaguchi. Just look at this girl's mesenteric vascular arcades—without anesthetic hypotension dulling them, they're pulsing like a work of art."

en.speaker: Narrator
en.text: Across the table, Takemi's eyes gleam above her mask. Gripping the abdominal wall retractor with her sterile-gloved hands, she sinks her wrists outward with practiced ease—widening an incision that was originally standard length by a full margin.

en.speaker: Female Patient
en.text: "Mmph...! W-Wait a second, Doctor... My stomach is being pulled so tight to both sides... I-I held still when you cut me open just now, but spreading it this wide makes my insides feel so strange...!"

en.speaker: Takashi Sakaguchi
en.text: "Takemi, the exposure is already plenty wide for me to work. You don't need to crank the retractor to the maximum."

en.speaker: Tae Takemi
en.text: "It's a rare opportunity. Hey, little scrub nurse holding the tray over there—Honjo, was it? Lean in a bit closer."

en.speaker: Moe Honjo
en.text: "Eh? M-Me? Yes, ma'am!"

en.speaker: Narrator
en.text: Moe inches forward half a step timidly. Using atraumatic tissue forceps, Takemi gently lifts the patient's faintly蠕动ing terminal ileum and mesenteric root, pointing them out as if giving a demonstration in a university lecture hall:

en.speaker: Tae Takemi
en.text: "All you ever see in nursing textbooks are lifeless illustrations, right? Look closely right here—while the patient is awake, the moment my forceps lightly graze the serosa, the bowel contracts and pulls away on its own, and you can watch every tiny vasa recta beating one pulse after another."

en.speaker: Moe Honjo
en.text: "Whoa... It's really moving on its own...! So this is what living internal organs actually look like... It's so much clearer than the diagrams in our textbook..."

en.speaker: Female Patient
en.text: "Uu...! Um, Doctors, Nurse... Please don't discuss the quality of the teaching material right in front of the teaching material herself while rummaging around inside my belly...!"

en.speaker: Takashi Sakaguchi
en.text: "Alright, Professor Takemi's live anatomy lecture is adjourned. Moe, hand me the curved hemostat; Takemi, hold the retractor steady for me so we can address the lesion."

en.speaker: Tae Takemi
en.text: "Tch, how strict. Still, your incision is remarkably clean, without a single drop of wasted bleeding—assisting a lead surgeon like you isn't half bad."

en.speaker: Narrator
en.text: By the time the operation wraps up smoothly and the patient is wheeled back to the ward for observation, it is just past eleven. Following the stairs down to the Underground Research Lab on the lowest level of the hospital, I push open the door to find Tae Takemi lounging in her swivel chair with her long legs crossed, sipping an iced coffee.

en.speaker: Tae Takemi
en.text: "Yo, Lead Surgeon. What brings you down here—delivering a lecture on behalf of that little Director Shiromiya, or settling the score with me for widening the retractor at the table?"

en.speaker: Takashi Sakaguchi
en.text: "If I wanted to lecture you, I would've done it at the scrub sink. Though after Moe blurted out that your explanation was clearer than a textbook, the girls at the nurses' station have fresh material for their hospital ghost stories about you."

en.speaker: Tae Takemi
en.text: "Ghost stories? Let me guess—are they whispering again that 'that woman named Takemi in the basement is actually a madwoman whose ultimate hobby is performing vivisections on living people'?"

en.speaker: Tae Takemi
en.text: "Haha, aside from that girl Shiromiya, you're the first person in this hospital with the nerve to ask me that to my face."

en.speaker: Takashi Sakaguchi
en.text: "After standing across the table from you through a whole operation, pretending not to notice would be harder."

en.speaker: Tae Takemi
en.text: "Look who's talking, Dr. Sakaguchi. A man who cuts that steadily without a drop of anesthesia has no business calling me a freak."

en.speaker: Takashi Sakaguchi
en.text: "I do it for clinical training and special indications. Meanwhile, the nurses are whispering that your ultimate hobby is 'vivisection.'"

en.speaker: Tae Takemi
en.text: "Laypeople have given the word 'vivisection' such an ugly ring. As if the mere mention of dissecting a living body means you have to torture the subject to death on the table."

en.speaker: Narrator
en.text: Setting down her coffee cup, she leans forward slightly, her dark-painted lips curving into a matter-of-fact smile:

en.speaker: Tae Takemi
en.text: "Back when I was in middle school, we had a frog dissection lab in biology class. The whole class was making a huge fuss, snipping their frogs' bellies into a mangled mess."

en.speaker: Tae Takemi
en.text: "I found it baffling—if our goal was simply to observe the beating heart, the expanding lungs, and the course of the intestines in a living state, why did everyone assume the frog had to die?"

en.speaker: Takashi Sakaguchi
en.text: "...So what did you do?"

en.speaker: Tae Takemi
en.text: "I opened the abdominal cavity while avoiding every major vessel, observed every single beating organ inside from top to bottom, and finished my anatomical drawings; then I used the finest suture needle and thread I'd brought from home to close it back up layer by layer, and flipped it back over on the wax tray."

en.speaker: Takashi Sakaguchi
en.text: "And then? Did it survive?"

en.speaker: Tae Takemi
en.text: "It kicked its hind legs and hopped right off the lab table on its own."

en.speaker: Narrator
en.text: She delivers the line with utter calm, as though recounting nothing more remarkable than a home-economics sewing assignment.

en.speaker: Takashi Sakaguchi
en.text: "...Your biology teacher's face must have been a sight to behold."

en.speaker: Tae Takemi
en.text: "The teacher nearly dropped his lesson plan. And doesn't the exact same logic apply here at Hoshimi Hospital? Since our medical safeguards guarantee that no matter how wide we open an incision or how thoroughly we examine the organs inside, the patient will heal without a scratch once sutured back up—what's wrong with taking a closer look while she's wide awake and her organs are pulsing right in front of us?"

en.speaker: Takashi Sakaguchi
en.text: "So Director Shiromiya banned you from routine lead surgery because you wanted to treat patients like that middle-school frog?"

en.speaker: Tae Takemi
en.text: "I only opened that last case a little deeper than usual—who knew the hydraulic bracket on the old operating table in OR 3 was so flimsy it would jam halfway through? That girl Shiromiya made a mountain out of a molehill, claiming if I kept cutting I'd dismantle the patient and the table together."

en.speaker: Narrator
en.text: Leaning lazily back against her chair, she looks me up and down with the amused glint of someone who has found a kindred spirit:

en.speaker: Tae Takemi
en.text: "Still, standing across from you as first assistant is surprisingly pleasant. At least when I widened the retractor earlier, your hands didn't waver a millimeter—in fact, your eyes looked even more focused than mine."

en.speaker: Takashi Sakaguchi
en.text: "As long as it doesn't get in the way of the actual procedure, I don't mind letting you slip in a two-minute anatomy lesson for the rookies."

en.speaker: Tae Takemi
en.text: "The only downside is that ordinary patients are still too squeamish. Even without anesthesia, the second you pull the retractor two centimeters wider or reach inside to turn over a loop of bowel, they start hollering in pain and ruin the quiet."

en.speaker: Narrator
en.text: Resting her index finger lightly against her chin, Takemi lets out a wistful sigh as if making a casual wish:

en.speaker: Tae Takemi
en.text: "If only a **patient who naturally feels no pain at all** would walk into our clinic one day. No anesthesia needed, and no screaming when we open her up... If a case like that ever shows up, I'll go straight to Shiromiya for a special-approval lead surgery permit, draft you as my first assistant, and inspect a living abdominal cavity from top to bottom to my heart's content."

en.speaker: Takashi Sakaguchi
en.text: "What are the odds of that? If someone actually had congenital insensitivity to pain, she wouldn't even notice when she fell ill—by the time she walked into a hospital, who knows how badly her insides would have festered."

en.speaker: Tae Takemi
en.text: "Wouldn't that make it even more fascinating? We'd get to admire healthy living anatomy *and* clean up a complex mess in one go. ...Alright, it's hampir twelve noon—go grab your lunch, partner. And if you have any more unanesthetized cases this afternoon, be sure to call me."

en.speaker: Narrator
en.text: Nine o'clock in the morning. Barely after clocking in for the day, a phone call from Tae Takemi summons me to the Director's Office. Behind her desk, young Director Asuka Shiromiya holds a referral chart, eyeing Takemi across from her with high alert.

en.speaker: Asuka Shiromiya
en.text: "I'm confirming this one last time, Dr. Takemi. This twenty-year-old university student, Ms. Fujino Asagami, had repeated perforations from chronic appendicitis masked by long-term insensitivity to pain, forming an extensive inflammatory mass in her right lower quadrant involving the ileocecal region, greater omentum, and right adnexa—and that is the *only* reason I'm granting special approval for you to lead the surgery with Dr. Sakaguchi as First Assistant."

en.speaker: Tae Takemi
en.text: "I know, I'm the one who screened her chart from outpatient yesterday. Sakaguchi's blade work is rock-solid now; with him across the table holding retractors and managing hemostasis, what could you possibly be worried about?"

en.speaker: Asuka Shiromiya
en.text: "The person I'm worried about is you! Listen carefully—First, perform the surgery normally."

en.speaker: Tae Takemi
en.text: "Naturally."

en.speaker: Asuka Shiromiya
en.text: "Second, no pulling junior nurses over for impromptu live anatomy lectures at the operating table."

en.speaker: Tae Takemi
en.text: "Asakura is assigned as scrub nurse today; she knows the anatomy as well as I do, so there's nothing to teach her."

en.speaker: Asuka Shiromiya
en.text: "And third—**you are strictly forbidden from taking advantage of the patient's lack of pain to widen the surgical field and rummage around healthy organs!**"

en.speaker: Asuka Shiromiya
en.text: "Why did you suddenly go silent?! Answer me! Dr. Sakaguchi, besides serving as First Assistant at the table today, your job is to keep a close eye on her hands for me!"

en.speaker: Takashi Sakaguchi
en.text: "Rest assured, Director. I'll make sure the operation is completed safely along standard anatomical planes."

en.speaker: Narrator
en.text: Leaving the Director's Office, Takemi and I head to Examination Room 1. Seated beside the exam table is a young woman with waist-length jet-black hair and a poised, gentle demeanor—Fujino Asagami.

en.speaker: Fujino Asagami
en.text: "Good morning, Dr. Takemi, Dr. Sakaguchi. I am deeply grateful to have two specialists scrubbing in together for my sake today."

en.speaker: Narrator
en.text: She inclines her head with a graceful smile, every gesture carrying the refined upbringing of an old-family heiress—giving zero hint that deep inside her right lower abdomen lies a suppurating, adherent mass severe enough to send an ordinary person into shock from pain.

en.speaker: Tae Takemi
en.text: "Save the formalities, Ms. Asagami. We'll do one final pre-op abdominal palpation to confirm the margins—lie down on the exam table, unfasten your skirt waistband, and pull your sweater up above your chest."

en.speaker: Fujino Asagami
en.text: "Very well. Excuse me."

en.speaker: Narrator
en.text: Obediently lying flat on the examination table, Asagami rolls the hem of her knit sweater upward with slender fingers, baring a flat, toned waist and abdomen without an ounce of excess flesh.

en.speaker: Tae Takemi
en.text: "Put on a pair of gloves and feel this for yourself, Sakaguchi. With a right lower quadrant inflammatory mass of this size, an ordinary girl would scream and arch off the bed the instant your fingertips touched her skin."

en.speaker: Narrator
en.text: Snapping on exam gloves, I step up to the bedside, lay my palm gently over the cool skin of Asagami's right lower abdomen, and press all four fingers slowly and firmly deep into her abdominal cavity.

en.speaker: Narrator
en.text: Through the supple muscle layer of her abdominal wall, the pads of my fingers clearly meet a hard, unyielding mass tightly adherent to the surrounding bowel loops and pelvic wall. Yet the young woman lying beneath my hand doesn't even furrow her brow—only a faint blush creeps up the tips of her ears at the sensation of a man's hand pressing deep into her lower belly.

en.speaker: Fujino Asagami
en.text: "Mmn... Your hand is stronger than I imagined, Dr. Sakaguchi... I can feel your fingers sinking all the way into the deepest part of my stomach, pressing against that hard lump... It's just that I truly don't feel any pain at all."

en.speaker: Takashi Sakaguchi
en.text: "Precisely because your sensory pathways have been blocked for years, repeated bouts of appendicitis and perforation were registered by your body as mere mild bloating—allowing the inflammation to weld your ileocecal region, greater omentum, and the area around your right ovary and fallopian tube into a single mass."

en.speaker: Tae Takemi
en.text: "Moreover, based on the imaging review I did with Dr. Misono in Radiology, the dense scar tissue deep in your right lower quadrant is directly compressing the retroperitoneal nerve plexus—in other words, a large part of your current insensitivity to pain is actually being locked in place by this chronic lesion itself."

en.speaker: Fujino Asagami
en.text: "I see... No wonder I barely felt anything even when I sprained my ankle these past two years. Then regarding the method for this afternoon's surgery..."

en.speaker: Tae Takemi
en.text: "Just as we explained earlier, operating under general anesthesia would mask the critical threshold response of your nerve function; and since you feel no pain right now anyway, we'll perform an **unanesthetized laparotomy with zero anesthesia**. Do you have the nerve to sign?"

en.speaker: Fujino Asagami
en.text: "Since I don't feel pain to begin with, skipping anesthesia should be gentler on my body, shouldn't it? Only... I heard that once you sign Hoshimi Hospital's surgical consent form, you cannot cancel halfway through once you're on the operating table, even if you get scared?"

en.speaker: Takashi Sakaguchi
en.text: "That's right. Once you sign and enter the pre-op workflow, the operation will not stop until we've resected the lesion cleanly and sutured your abdomen back up."

en.speaker: Fujino Asagami
en.text: "I understand. Since I won't cry or make a fuss from pain anyway, I place myself in your hands, Dr. Takemi, Dr. Sakaguchi."

en.speaker: Narrator
en.text: Twelve-thirty p.m. After Miyuki Asakura completes full skin prep, bowel cleansing, and indwelling urinary catheterization for Asagami in the ward, the stark-naked black-haired girl is wheeled into the operating room and positioned flat on the table directly beneath the shadowless lamp.

en.speaker: Miyuki Asakura
en.text: "Both arm restraints are secured, the Foley catheter is draining smoothly, and povidone-iodine prep across the abdomen and perineum is complete. From undressing and catheterization in the ward up till now, Ms. Asagami's heart rate has barely ticked up—such a sweet, obedient patient it almost makes my heart ache."

en.speaker: Fujino Asagami
en.text: "Because... even though I can't feel pain, lying here completely undressed while wide awake, with a tube between my legs and three medical staff looking down at me... is still deeply embarrassing..."

en.speaker: Tae Takemi
en.text: "Blushing proves your tactile and emotional responses are in great shape. Come on, Asakura, hand me a #20 scalpel; Sakaguchi, have dry gauze ready to brace both sides of the incision."

en.speaker: Narrator
en.text: Once the sterile fenestrated drape is laid, Takemi doesn't hesitate for a split second, bringing the sharp blade steadily down just right of the midline across Asagami's flat, snow-white abdomen. Skin and pale-yellow subcutaneous fat part cleanly, and the bright red beads of blood that well up are immediately blotted away by my gauze.

en.speaker: Narrator
en.text: Next comes the electrocautery dividing the anterior rectus sheath, blunt separation of the deep-red rectus abdominis muscle belly, and lifting the translucent peritoneum to snip it open—the entire abdominal entry is executed with surgical perfection. Astonishingly, apart from a faint flutter of her eyelashes as the blade parted her skin, Asagami's breathing on the table remains completely steady.

en.speaker: Fujino Asagami
en.text: "Mmn... Just now I felt a cool blade gliding across my stomach, followed by the sensation of it parting to both sides... So this is what it feels like to have one's abdomen cut open? It really... doesn't hurt a bit."

en.speaker: Narrator
en.text: Above her surgical mask, Tae Takemi's eyes light up with startling intensity. Setting a Balfour self-retaining abdominal retractor into the wound, she ratchets the metal blades wide open with several clicks, laying Asagami's abdominal cavity generously bare beneath the shadowless lamp—then suddenly pauses her hands and looks down with a purring smile at the wide-awake girl:

en.speaker: Tae Takemi
en.text: "Say, Ms. Asagami. As you can see, your belly is now wide open, and you genuinely don't feel an ounce of pain."

en.speaker: Fujino Asagami
en.text: "Yes... Is something the matter, Dr. Takemi?"

en.speaker: Tae Takemi
en.text: "Since we've already opened you up and an opportunity like this comes once in a blue moon... before we resect that inflamed, adherent mess in your lower right side, how about we take a thorough, detailed look through all the other healthy organs inside your belly from top to bottom?"

en.speaker: Takashi Sakaguchi
en.text: "Hey, Takemi, did you already forget Item Three from Director Shiromiya this morning?"

en.speaker: Miyuki Asakura
en.text: "Hehe, I knew there was no way Dr. Takemi could resist going straight to business when presented with a patient this obedient who doesn't cry out in pain."

en.speaker: Narrator
en.text: Yet lying on the operating table, Fujino Asagami blinks her clear dark eyes and asks a question in dead earnest that freezes all three of us in our tracks:

en.speaker: Fujino Asagami
en.text: "Excuse me... if you inspect the rest of my insides along the way, will the surgery fee remain the same?"

en.speaker: Tae Takemi
en.text: "Pfft... Haha! Exactly the same—not a single yen extra. Consider it a complimentary full-course internal organ checkup courtesy of your lead surgeon."

en.speaker: Fujino Asagami
en.text: "If the fee is the same and I don't feel any pain anyway... then please do as you both see fit. Feel free to inspect as thoroughly as you like."

en.speaker: Tae Takemi
en.text: "Hear that, Asakura? Even our First Assistant voted in favor. Bring over the warm sterile saline so we can wet our gloves first."

en.speaker: Takashi Sakaguchi
en.text: "I just know that unless you get this out of your system first, you won't focus on dissecting the actual lesion."

en.speaker: Tae Takemi
en.text: "Relax, don't you know my touch by now? I'll be ten times gentler than I was with that middle-school frog."

en.speaker: Takashi Sakaguchi
en.text: "Don't bring up your middle-school frog in front of the patient—Ms. Asagami will take you seriously."

en.speaker: Narrator
en.text: With Asagami's express permission secured, Takemi drops all restraint. Dipping both gloved hands in warm saline, she reaches straight into the depths of Asagami's wide-open abdominal cavity—starting from the greater curvature of the stomach and transverse colon in the upper abdomen, lifting and turning over the rosy, living organs rising and falling with her breath inch by inch.

en.speaker: Fujino Asagami
en.text: "Mmph...! Haah... W-Wait a moment, Dr. Takemi..."

en.speaker: Tae Takemi
en.text: "What is it? Does it hurt?"

en.speaker: Fujino Asagami
en.text: "N-No, it isn't pain... It truly doesn't hurt at all... Only, when your hands reach deep inside my stomach and lift my intestines up... there's an indescribable sinking, tugging sensation inside... as if my organs are about to be lifted right out of me... Nnh, haah..."

en.speaker: Narrator
en.text: Insensitivity to pain blocks sharp nociception, but leaves deep visceral proprioception and vagal traction reflexes intact. As Takemi's slick latex-gloved fingers run loop by loop along the small bowel mesentery toward the pelvis, fine beads of sweat break out across Asagami's pale forehead, her breathing growing rapid and shallow.

en.speaker: Tae Takemi
en.text: "Don't just stand there watching, Sakaguchi—put your hands in and help me cradle these loops of jejunum and ileum gently toward the upper left. Look at her left ovary and fallopian tube down here in the pelvis—completely untouched by the inflammation on the right, and such a lovely color."

en.speaker: Narrator
en.text: Following Takemi's lead, I slide both sterile-gloved hands into Asagami's warm, slick abdominal cavity, gently cradling her soft,蠕动ing loops of small intestine in my palms to sweep them aside—while Takemi's fingers glide down along the uterine fundus to the left adnexa, lightly rolling the healthy ovary and fimbriae between her fingertips.

en.speaker: Fujino Asagami
en.text: "Kyaa...! Mmn, nnh...! Dr. Sakaguchi... Dr. Takemi... Having four hands moving around inside my belly at the same time... f-feels way too strange...!"

en.speaker: Takashi Sakaguchi
en.text: "Bear with it a moment, Ms. Asagami. Right now my palms are supporting your small intestine while Dr. Takemi verifies your healthy left uterine adnexa."

en.speaker: Fujino Asagami
en.text: "Haah... I-I know you're examining me... Yet even though it doesn't hurt, why does having Dr. Sakaguchi's palms cradling my intestines while Dr. Takemi touches the deepest part of my lower belly... make my insides feel so heavy and achy that even my toes are going weak... Uu, it feels so weird... Every inch inside my stomach is being touched..."

en.speaker: Miyuki Asakura
en.text: "Hehe, your face is flushed as red as if you had a fever, Ms. Asagami. Even without pain, having the most private depths of a girl's belly felt over inch by inch by the lead surgeon and assistant carries a shame even stronger than pain."

en.speaker: Fujino Asagami
en.text: "Mmn... P-Please don't say it out loud, Nurse Asakura... I can even feel my intestines squirming against your palms inside my head... Are you not finished inspecting yet...?"

en.speaker: Tae Takemi
en.text: "Alright, I've had my fill of admiring the healthy parts—truly a gorgeous specimen of a body. —Time to get down to business. Sakaguchi, shift the retractors toward the right iliac fossa."

en.speaker: Narrator
en.text: Having satisfied her curiosity, Takemi's eyes turn hawk-sharp in an instant. Every trace of her languid playfulness vanishes, replaced by top-tier surgical dominance on par with Emiko Mido herself.

en.speaker: Narrator
en.text: Deep within Asagami's right lower quadrant, thick脓 cavities and granulation scars formed by years of silently perforating chronic appendicitis have encased the lower cecum, part of the greater omentum, and the ampulla of the right fallopian tube into a rock-hard inflammatory mass, with dense fibrous bands at its base pressing directly against the retroperitoneal nerve plexus.

en.speaker: Takashi Sakaguchi
en.text: "The right fallopian tube and ovary are only encased by inflammatory fibrous adhesions—the parenchyma itself isn't necrotic. With meticulous dissection, we can preserve her right adnexa completely and only resect the necrotic appendiceal base, the inflamed ileocecal tissue, and the involved omentum."

en.speaker: Tae Takemi
en.text: "Right in line with my thinking. I have no taste for lopping off a young girl's useful parts unnecessarily. Asakura, switch to fine dissecting forceps and bipolar cautery; Sakaguchi, hold traction on the right ovarian ligament for me and don't let it budge a millimeter."

en.speaker: Narrator
en.text: Under the shadowless lamp, only the crisp slap of instruments and the soft sizzle of bipolar cautery remain. Takemi's blade moves with breathtaking speed and precision, navigating effortlessly through vascularized adhesion bands until Asagami's intact right ovary and fallopian tube are freed completely unscathed from the outer wall of the mass.

en.speaker: Fujino Asagami
en.text: "Mmn... The tugging deep in the right side of my stomach is getting heavier... Like a stone is being peeled off my flesh bit by bit... Haah, it still doesn't hurt, so please continue..."

en.speaker: Tae Takemi
en.text: "We're right at the deepest scar root compressing the nerve plexus. Sakaguchi, clamp the ileocecal mesenteric vessels and prepare to ligate and divide—"

en.speaker: Narrator
en.text: The moment I secure the double ligatures, Takemi's Metzenbaum scissors reach deep into the retroperitoneum, aligning squarely with the dense inflammatory root strangling the sensory nerve pathway, and snip cleanly all the way through—

en.speaker: Narrator
en.text: *Snip.* The dark-red inflammatory mass that had tormented and locked away Fujino Asagami's bodily sensations for years is completely excised, dropping into the kidney dish in Asakura's hands.

en.speaker: Narrator
en.text: And in the exact same split second that the lesion separates from the retroperitoneal nerve plexus—

en.speaker: Narrator
en.text: Asagami's brow, which had only been lightly knitted from traction, freezes abruptly as her pupils contract to pinpricks. The next instant, nociceptive signals dammed up for years surge like a bursting levee straight from her wide-open, oozing right lower abdominal cavity into her cerebral cortex!

en.speaker: Fujino Asagami
en.text: "—KYAAAAAAAAAAAAAHHH—!!!"

en.speaker: Narrator
en.text: A piercing, pitch-shattered scream rips through the operating room! The poised heiress who had lain calmly while we turned her organs over in our hands a moment ago arches violently off the table, her wrists yanking the leather restraints with loud snaps as fat tears burst from her eyes!

en.speaker: Fujino Asagami
en.text: "IT HURTS!! IT HURTS SO MUCH—!! My stomach—why does my stomach suddenly feel like it's being burned with fire and sliced with knives?!! Uwaaaahhh—!!"

en.speaker: Takashi Sakaguchi
en.text: "Her heart rate just spiked to 130! Asakura, hold her shoulders down so her thrashing doesn't eviscerate the bowel loops through the incision! Excising that retroperitoneal mass just released the compression block on her nerve plexus—her sense of pain woke up right on the table!"

en.speaker: Fujino Asagami
en.text: "Dr. Takemi!! Dr. Sakaguchi!! I don't want to do this without anesthesia anymore!! It hurts—my belly is really cut wide open and it hurts so much!! Give me anesthesia... I'm begging you, please put me under general anesthesia right now!! Uwaaaahhh—!!"

en.speaker: Narrator
en.text: Faced with Asagami sobbing and screaming for anesthesia on the table, Tae Takemi doesn't show a trace of panic; instead, she straightens her back unhurriedly, her eyes crinkling into a smile above her mask:

en.speaker: Tae Takemi
en.text: "Congratulations, Ms. Asagami. It looks like the operation is a resounding success—not only did we clean out the rotten mass, we cured your insensitivity to pain along the way."

en.speaker: Fujino Asagami
en.text: "Uwaaaahhh I don't want congratulations right now!! It hurts to death... Even taking a single breath makes my insides cramp in agony!! Anesthesia... I'll pay extra right now if I have to, just please give me anesthesia and put me to sleep!!"

en.speaker: Tae Takemi
en.text: "Asking for anesthesia now? Too late for that, Ms. Asagami."

en.speaker: Tae Takemi
en.text: "The hardest resection steps are already finished. All that's left is irrigating the abdominal cavity clean with warm saline, checking for bleeders, and suturing your belly closed layer by layer. Even if we paged Chief Sakura to come intubate you for general anesthesia right now, by the time the drugs kicked in, Sakaguchi and I would already have tied off the final skin suture."

en.speaker: Fujino Asagami
en.text: "H-How could that be...?! Doesn't that mean I have to lie here wide awake enduring the pain of having my insides washed out and my stomach sewed up stitch by stitch until the very end?!"

en.speaker: Fujino Asagami
en.text: "Uu... Dr. Sakaguchi... Even when your hand presses beside the incision, the sting of your glove brushing against the raw flesh is so vivid... Please hurry...!"

en.speaker: Tae Takemi
en.text: "Hear that, Lead Surgeon? The young lady is rushing us—though we can't cut corners on debridement and irrigation; we have to wash her out nice and thoroughly so she doesn't get a post-op infection."

en.speaker: Tae Takemi
en.text: "Feeling sorry for her already? Witnessing a painless patient regain her sense of pain right under your blade is a once-in-a-lifetime clinical moment."

en.speaker: Takashi Sakaguchi
en.text: "A miracle for the surgeons, maybe, but pure torture for Ms. Asagami on the table. Asakura, hand me the warm saline and suction."

en.speaker: Narrator
en.text: The next forty minutes become the young heiress's first true baptism of pain in her twenty years of life. As copious warm saline pours into her open abdominopelvic cavity to thoroughly irrigate the raw bed where the mass was dissected free, Asagami bites down hard on her lower lip, tears streaming endlessly down her temples into the edge of her surgical cap.

en.speaker: Fujino Asagami
en.text: "Mmn—!! Haah, ah... Th-The water is washing right over the raw wound inside my belly... It stings so much... Even when the suction tube draws the bloody water out, my insides are throbbing and cramping... uuu..."

en.speaker: Miyuki Asakura
en.text: "Good girl, hang in there just a little longer, Ms. Asagami. You didn't make a peep when we turned your whole belly inside out earlier, so being able to cry out in pain this loudly means your body is completely back to normal."

en.speaker: Narrator
en.text: Once irrigation is complete and we verify that her right adnexa and bowel loops are returned to their proper anatomical positions, Takemi and I begin closing the abdomen stitch by stitch, layer by layer. Every time the curved needle draws suture thread through the sensitive peritoneum, approximates the rectus sheath, and cinches a knot tight, Asagami's body tenses from the sharp piercing and pulling pain, letting out tearful gasps.

en.speaker: Fujino Asagami
en.text: "Ah...! Ow, that stitch pulled so tight... My stomach is being sewed shut one stitch at a time... Uu, I'm never believing 'skipping anesthesia is fine' ever again...!"

en.speaker: Tae Takemi
en.text: "Final subcuticular stitch—cut the thread. There, the wound edges are approximated beautifully. It won't even leave a scar."

en.speaker: Narrator
en.text: Five o'clock in the evening, post-operative observation ward. Thanks to Hoshimi Hospital's recovery guarantee, Fujino Asagami—who underwent a major laparotomy just hours ago—is already changed into a fresh hospital gown and propped up against the headboard, only a faint flush from her earlier crying bout lingering on her cheeks.

en.speaker: Narrator
en.text: When Takemi and I push open the door for our final end-of-shift rounds, Asagami is looking down and gingerly prodding her right lower abdomen through the thin gauze dressing with her fingertip—immediately sucking in a sharp *hiss* of breath.

en.speaker: Takashi Sakaguchi
en.text: "Stop poking at your incision—it was just sutured closed, so of course it still hurts."

en.speaker: Fujino Asagami
en.text: "I am so sorry, Dr. Sakaguchi, Dr. Takemi... Screaming and crying so ungracefully on the operating table at the end, and begging you relentlessly for anesthesia... I made a complete spectacle of myself in front of you both."

en.speaker: Tae Takemi
en.text: "No need to apologize. If you hadn't made a sound right after I freed the compression on your retroperitoneal nerve plexus with your belly still wide open, that would've meant my surgery failed."

en.speaker: Narrator
en.text: Lowering her eyelashes, Asagami rests both hands gently over her lower abdomen. Crystal tears well up at the corners of her eyes once more, yet her lips curve into a smile of unmistakable warmth:

en.speaker: Fujino Asagami
en.text: "Truthfully... after returning to the ward and calming down, feeling this steady, throbbing ache beneath my fingers feels almost miraculous to me."

en.speaker: Fujino Asagami
en.text: "Before today, no matter how badly my insides were festering, it felt like I was living behind a pane of frosted glass, unable to feel a thing. On the operating table earlier it hurt terribly, and the two of you inspected every inch inside my stomach... yet being able to feel pain like an ordinary girl, and having Dr. Sakaguchi scold me gently not to poke my incision, makes me feel from the bottom of my heart that I am truly alive."

en.speaker: Takashi Sakaguchi
en.text: "Your right ovary and fallopian tube were preserved completely intact, and the inflammatory mass is gone for good. Get a good night's sleep tonight, and you'll be free to walk around normally tomorrow."

en.speaker: Fujino Asagami
en.text: "Yes. Thank you both from the bottom of my heart."

en.speaker: Narrator
en.text: By the time we step out of the ward, six-o'clock twilight has settled outside the windows. Hands tucked into the pockets of her white coat, Tae Takemi strolls unhurriedly beside me down the corridor leading to the basement stairs.

en.speaker: Tae Takemi
en.text: "Phew... Now that was a fulfilling full day's work. We got to inspect a living abdominopelvic cavity in peace during the first half, and heard such a lively scream in the second."

en.speaker: Takashi Sakaguchi
en.text: "It's a good thing Ms. Asagami is good-natured. Any other patient who found out you threw in a 'complimentary full-abdominal manual inspection' while she couldn't feel pain would march straight into the Director's Office to report you before discharge."

en.speaker: Tae Takemi
en.text: "If she reports me, the First Assistant who had both hands inside her belly cradling her small intestine for me is an accomplice—there's no escaping for you either."

en.speaker: Narrator
en.text: Stopping at the top of the basement stairs, she turns to look at me, a rare glint of genuine approval shining in her usually languid, teasing eyes:

en.speaker: Tae Takemi
en.text: "Seriously though, Sakaguchi... when her pain suddenly came back and she started thrashing on the table, an ordinary assistant would have lost his head—yet you braced the incision to protect her bowel loops with one hand while matching my pace through irrigation and closure without missing a beat."

en.speaker: Tae Takemi
en.text: "In all my time at Hoshimi Hospital, you're the first man I've met who can keep up with my rhythm this comfortably. ...Come on, after a full day on our feet, come down to my lab for a drink—consider it a treat from your lead surgeon."
